game.name: Blood Bowl (Europe)
game.desc: Blood Bowl on Xbox 360 is a sports and strategy game adapted from the board game of the same name. A joyful mix of American football and wrestling, the title features teams of creatures from the world of Warhammer. Humans, Dwarves, Elves, Orcs, Skaven and Lizardmen go head-to-head on the field, occasionally trying to score touchdowns. The title can be played in real time or in turn-based mode, like the board game from which it was inspired.
